title: Takoyaki Bites
description: A Japanese-inspired breakfast dish featuring crispy takoyaki balls filled with eggs and served with a side of savory sauce.

ingredients.name: Nourishing Flour
ingredients.notes: Use a gluten-free flour if necessary

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the flour and water to form a smooth batter.
2. Add the Japanese sauce to the batter and mix until well combined.
3. Crack in the eggs and mix until the batter is smooth.
4. Heat a non-stick pan or takoyaki grill over medium heat.
5. Drop the batter into the pan, filling each cavity about 2/3 full.
6. Cook the takoyaki for 2-3 minutes, until the bottoms are golden brown.
7. Flip the takoyaki over and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
8. Serve the takoyaki hot with additional Japanese sauce for dipping.
